scopes.admin: Five fresh hosts/cohort,100 warmups+1000 measured authenticated setting reads,8clients; CPU/GC denominator1100 includes warmups/client startup+EOF validation,server background/observer. WS sampled100ms; startup/first read descriptive. Different from Gateway measured-only windows; no cross-service CPU comparison.
scopes.pricing: Five fresh writer+reader pairs/cohort;100 warmups+1000 measured/state,complete8-association graphs,distinct cold/L2 keys,owned immediateL1 under80ms versus unchanged100msTTL; restartedL2 forbids loaders. No SQL I/O/application-capacity claim.
scopes.pricingAllocation: GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(precise:true) before/after awaited operation; process-wide including background/runtime noise. ActualWorkstationGC, so this known.NET10ServerGC retired-heap defect does not apply; not thread-local/pure reconstruction allocation. Historical mode-missing figures remain unqualified.
scopes.adminAllocation: ALL.NET10.0.15ServerGC windows unavailable,positive deltas included (dotnet/runtime#131069). DefaultGC unchanged. Candidate allocations alone do not close the matched gate.
scopes.collector: Synchronous same-thread allocation,actual production snapshot-each-content-chunk pattern; one warmup+3measured streams/size/mode/process,5processes/cohort. Final-snapshot-only control is mechanistic,not deployed optimization; collector has List,no queue/drain API.
scopes.gcMetadata: ActualGCSettings mode and invariant GC configuration captured; configuration is not a live heap-count trace. Equal configurations collapsed by architecture/cohort/component.
